purpose: S2 natural LLM faults (docs/PHASE2_SPEC.md 8.8): wrong solutions that local models write for HumanEval+ tasks, paired with the canonical solution

generation.prompt_file: configs/s2_natural_prompt.txt (kept outside prompts/ so the harness fingerprint of queued runs is unchanged)

filter.base: passes HumanEval's original check() tests (the dataset's test field)
filter.plus: returns a different value than the canonical solution for at least one HumanEval+ input (base_input and plus_input)
filter.no_crash: raises no exception and finishes every input within the time limit
filter.float_tolerance: math.isclose with abs_tol = max(atol, 1e-6) and rel_tol = 1e-6; everything else must be equal

selection: one fault per task: the candidate that differs on the fewest inputs; ties broken by model order, then seed

pairs.buggy: the task's prompt (imports, signature, docstring) followed by the body of the model's function and any helper code it wrote
pairs.fixed: the task's prompt followed by the canonical solution
